title: Brandon AI
description: This is an ongoing project dedicated to democratizing access to trademarks for small businesses who can't afford expensive trademark lawyers and lack the expertise and resources necessary to navigate the process on their own.

title: This Website
description: I designed, deployed, and automated my personal website using a DigitalOcean droplet, Nginx, Cloudflare, and GitHub Actions. The site uses a release-based deployment system with atomic symlinks to ensure zero-downtime updates. GitHub Actions builds and rsyncs new versions to the server on every push to main, then flips the symlink and reloads Nginx.

title: Laundry Bot
description: This project uses a Raspberry Pi and vibration sensor to monitor your laundry and send you a notification when it's ready. We do this by characterizing the vibration patterns of your laundry and using a machine learning model to predict when it's ready.

title: Forays in Advanced Forest Planning with Dr. Pete Bettinger
description: Implemented exact and heuristic methods for constrained forest harvest scheduling in Dr. Bettinger’s Advanced Forest Planning course, including LP, MIP, binary search, genetic algorithm, simulated annealing, and tabu search.

title: AIDVISOR
description: This is my New Media Capstone project dedicated to leveraging LLMs and the OpenAI Assistants API to promote financial aid equity and improve access to scholarships, grants, and other resources for students.

title: Multi-Agent Debate for LLMs
description: Chain of thought reasoning is common today, but it is not always the best way to reason. This project explores the use of multi-agent debate to improve the reasoning of LLMs.

title: Linear Dynamical Systems for Texture Modeling
description: This project demonstrates the capabilities of the Moore-Penrose pseudoinverse for an interesting application of linear dynamical systems.

title: Sherwood
description: Trust, but verify. Sherwood is a tool for analyzing the trading activity of politicians. It uses various data sources to provide a comprehensive view of the trading activity of politicians.

title: Logistic Regression with Evolutionary Algorithm
description: This project demonstrates a classic machine learning classification algorithm with a bit of a twist. Instead of using stochastic gradient descent for optimization, we use an evolutionary algorithm to optimize the parameters of the logistic regression model.

title: Wordsearch
description: This wordsearch program is able to read input from separate files, wordbank.txt and wordpuzzle.txt, and then perform a searching algorithim using the information parsed from the files to solve the wordsearch puzzle.

title: Code Cracker
description: This is a simple brute force program that reads through a dictionary.txt file and automatically tries every password sequentially.
